user_story: As a user, I want to see my profile information after logging in so that I can confirm my account details.

positive.title: Verify that profile information is displayed after successful login
positive.expected_result: User is redirected to the profile page and the profile information is displayed.

negative.title: Profile information is not displayed with invalid login
negative.expected_result: User receives an error message and remains on the login page; the profile information is not displayed.

edge.title: Profile information display with special characters in username
steps: Enter a username with special characters and a valid password.
edge.expected_result: User is redirected to the profile page and the profile information is displayed if username is valid. Otherwise, user receives an error message.
